{"notes": "Visit 5 (left at 10:00). Time is up. Nobody said or did anything I could see, and no hands were on the table, so there is no new evidence on any individual. The fish is unchanged: dark and connected from the nose through the top and bottom curves to the tail join and both lobes. The two pale loose dominoes are still at the tail join, off the chain. The tail join is the weak point for the push. I still don't know who placed what, so I'm rating the team result, not individuals, until I ask.

Tom: Verified the full fish at 5:15, sensibly left the loose dominoes alone, credited Leo and called hands off. His bottom curve is strong. Good verification, calm judgment and collaboration. I never saw him build, so I'm giving him no extra credit for execution.

Maya: Checked the tail lobes at 5:00, thanked Leo and called hands off. The top curve was her task and it is complete, but I never saw her finish it, so I'm crediting it with caution.

Leo: Both Maya and Tom credited him for the tail lobes, so a real contribution is likely but unconfirmed. I never saw the right-end join check he promised. The pale pair at the join suggests it may not have been finished.

Priya: Silent in the last visits. Her early tail split and lower lobe still count as good initiative and clear communication, but that evidence is old.

Next: privately ask each person who laid the upper lobe, who finished the top curve and who did the join check. Then watch the push, especially the tail join and the pale pair."}
